query:
We final-polish phenolic (Bakelite)-mounted, as-built laser powder bed fusion AlSi10Mg on a Buehler VibroMet 2 vibratory polisher for quantitative SEM-EDS (5-15 kV). Until now the final step was 0.05 um colloidal silica for about 4-5 hours. When the puck came out of the bowl, the operator had to keep spraying the face with methanol, continuously, until it was cleaned, because colloidal silica left on the face starts drying, gelling and crystallizing within seconds of air exposure, bonds to the surface and is then very hard to remove; residual silica also adds Si to the EDS result. We are replacing colloidal silica with a water-based polycrystalline diamond suspension, 0.1 um (PACE Technologies DIAMAT WPC-0110: about 94-98% water, diamond, <=0.1% polyethylene glycol, <=0.2% surfactant; the vendor confirms no silica or alumina), on a low-nap synthetic polishing cloth with adhesive backing.
Questions:
(1) Does a 0.1 um water-based diamond suspension require the same keep-it-wet, continuous alcohol (methanol) spray handling when the specimen is removed, as colloidal silica does? Explain the mechanism that makes colloidal silica dry, gel and bond to a polished surface (sol-gel condensation, pH, Si-O-metal bonding, particle size and surface area) and whether a diamond suspension shares any of it. What residue, if any, does a dried water-based diamond suspension leave on aluminum (diamond particles, PEG or surfactant films), and how hard is it to remove compared with dried colloidal silica?
(2) What cleaning sequence after the final diamond step do the literature and manufacturers (Buehler, Struers, PACE, Allied, QATM/ATM) recommend for aluminum alloys: water rinse, detergent or soap, swabbing, ethanol or methanol or isopropanol rinse, ultrasonic time, drying with warm air or nitrogen? Is methanol specifically needed, or is ethanol or isopropanol equivalent?
(3) Does the water in the suspension, or a delay before cleaning, cause staining, pitting, hydroxide or oxide growth on Al-Si alloys that would change quantitative EDS (O, Al, Si, Mg), and how quickly?
Cite primary literature and manufacturer application notes where possible, and say clearly where evidence is missing.
